title: Require cinematic story evidence across illustration scenes
starting_state: A carousel visual plan repeatedly says cozy home, warm room, plants, and couple moment.
It lacks motivated light, camera position, depth, before-after implication, and observable story evidence.
done_when: The production cinematic validator covers wedding action, landscape wide, kitchen support, and intimate close-up scenes.
Each relevant slide names camera position, motivated light, depth layers, before-after implication, observable evidence, negative space, and continuation or payoff.
Generic cozy-home filler, posed portraits, empty depth, and repeated medium two-shots block visual approval.
forbidden_changes: Do not treat random plants, chai, books, or beige rooms as story proof.
Do not weaken the existing visual-variety shot ladder.
Do not make the aesthetic a generic Pinterest/interior-design checklist.
fail_to_pass: generic plans are rejected unless they provide complete cinematic story evidence fields
pass_to_pass: four distinct scene families pass without being forced into domestic props
anti_gaming_notes: Hidden checker should replace 'home' with apartment, kitchen, vanity, doorway, or living room and require concrete fields, not the exact phrase home-cinematic.
